name: Character Art
original_description:
Describe a hero, a villain or a mascot and get an original character: a portrait, a full-body figure or a character sheet with front, side and back views.

Tell ChatGPT who the character is, the world or genre and the art style. The plugin prepares a draft with the view and the image model. When you confirm, Abracadabrax renders the character and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

For game masters, game developers, writers and anyone building a world.

Limitations: original characters from text only. It does not draw copyrighted or existing characters or real people, and it does not edit uploaded images. Producing needs a signed-in Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
